# Project Atlas — Compiled Specification Summary

> **SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE — FICTIONAL DATA.**
> This document was compiled quickly from memory and notes. Its author states that the
> sources were not re-checked before it was written. It conflicts with the project's
> own design and test records on several points.

## Summary table

| Item | Value in this summary | Where it conflicts |
|---|---|---|
| Battery capacity | 6400 mAh | design-revisions.md REV-C says 5200 mAh; REV-B says 5000 mAh |
| Battery voltage | 14.8 V | design-revisions.md says 14.4 V in REV-B and REV-C |
| Enclosure ingress rating | IP65 | design-revisions.md says IP54 in REV-A, REV-B and REV-C |
| Public field trial date | 2025-05-13 | progress-log.md says 2025-05-06 |
| Temperature sensor accuracy | plus or minus 0.6 degrees C | test-results.md T-02 says plus or minus 0.3 degrees C |
| Total vehicle mass | 4.9 kg | design-revisions.md REV-B estimated 5.8 kg; REV-C recorded no mass |
| Wheel motor speed | 90 rpm | design-revisions.md REV-A says 60 rpm |

## Author note

The author of this summary did not compare it against the design revision record, the
test results document or the progress log. The values above may be out of date.
